links.outcome: Reading level of institutional cardiac amyloidosis patient materials versus 6th-grade recommendation
links.effect: None of the institutional PEMs met the 6th-grade level; median FKGL 10.9 (IQR 9.2, 12.6).
links.quote: None of the institutional PEMs met the recommended 6th-grade reading level and had a median Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL) of 10.9 (high school freshman; IQR: 9.2, 12.6, p<0.001).

links.outcome: Readability of GPT-4 revised patient education materials versus institutional originals
links.effect: GPT-4 reduced median FKGL from 10.9 to 7.8 (IQR 7.0, 8.8); only 14/86 (16.3%) reached at least 6th-grade level.
links.quote: In comparison, GPT-4 revised PEMs reduced the median FKGL to 7.8 (seventh grade; IQR: 7.0, 8.8, p<0.001), with 14/86 (16.3%) achieving at least a 6th-grade reading level.
